criteria.iso_table: Accept only codes present in the language-version-pinned ISO 4217 table with their pinned minor-unit scales; any other code fails validation at the boundary where it is checked.
criteria.wellformed_default: Accept any three-letter code matching ^[A-Z]{3}$; codes absent from the scale table silently use a default scale of 2.
criteria.wellformed_deferred: Accept any three-letter code matching ^[A-Z]{3}$ as a currency value; fail only later, at the first money construction or arithmetic that needs its unknown scale.

criteria.preserve_scale: Emit the value's stored scale verbatim, so 1.50 and 1.5 encode differently.
criteria.strip_zeros: Normalize by stripping trailing fractional zeros (integral values carry no decimal point; negative zero encodes as 0), so each numeric value has exactly one encoding.
criteria.width_18: Emit every decimal with exactly 18 fractional digits.

criteria.eq_false_ord_fail: Equality (==/!=) compares structurally so mismatched currencies are simply unequal, while ordering (<,<=,>,>=) with mismatched currencies fails.
criteria.ignore_currency: All comparisons use minor units only and ignore the currency field.
criteria.reject_all: Any comparison, including ==, with mismatched currencies fails.
